text: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves is a celebrated destination in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, renowned for its heritage, caves, ancient ruins. Located in the historic and scenic region of Odisha, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Odisha. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to March (mild winter season avoiding summer humidity). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
